<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI"
                  xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC"
                  xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_LoanProcess"
                  targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn"
                  exporter="BPMN Diagram Assistant"
                  exporterVersion="1.0">

  <bpmn:process id="Process_LoanApplication" name="Loan Application Process" isExecutable="true">
    <!-- Start Event -->
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_LoanApplied" name="Loan Application Received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_To_CreditCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <!-- Credit Check Task -->
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CreditCheck" name="Perform Credit Check">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_To_CreditCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_To_Gateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <!-- Exclusive Gateway -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CheckPassed" name="Credit Check Passed?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_To_Gateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Passed</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Failed</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <!-- Approved Path -->
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ApproveLoan" name="Approve Loan">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Passed</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_To_ApprovedEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Approved" name="Loan Approved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_To_ApprovedEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <!-- Rejected Path -->
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRejection" name="Send Rejection Letter">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Failed</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_To_RejectedEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Rejected" name="Loan Rejected">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_To_RejectedEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <!-- Sequence Flows -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_To_CreditCheck" sourceRef="StartEvent_LoanApplied" targetRef="Task_CreditCheck" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_To_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_CreditCheck" targetRef="Gateway_CheckPassed" />
    
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Passed" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_CheckPassed" targetRef="Task_ApproveLoan">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${creditScore >= 650}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Failed" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_CheckPassed" targetRef="Task_SendRejection">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${creditScore < 650}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_To_ApprovedEnd" sourceRef="Task_ApproveLoan" targetRef="EndEvent_Approved" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_To_RejectedEnd" sourceRef="Task_SendRejection" targetRef="EndEvent_Rejected" />
  </bpmn:process>

  <!-- Diagram Visual Elements -->
  <bpmndi:BPMNDiagram id="BPMNDiagram_LoanProcess">
    <bpmndi:BPMNPlane id="BPMNPlane_LoanProcess" bpmnElement="Process_LoanApplication">
      <!-- Start Event Shape -->
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Shape_StartEvent_LoanApplied" bpmnElement="StartEvent_LoanApplied">
        <dc:Bounds x="160" y="162" width="36" height="36" />
        <bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
          <dc:Bounds x="135" y="205" width="87" height="27" />
        </bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>

      <!-- Credit Check Task Shape -->
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Shape_Task_CreditCheck" bpmnElement="Task_CreditCheck">
        <dc:Bounds x="250" y="140" width="100" height="80" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>

      <!-- Exclusive Gateway Shape -->
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Shape_Gateway_CheckPassed" bpmnElement="Gateway_CheckPassed" isMarkerVisible="true">
        <dc:Bounds x="410" y="155" width="50" height="50" />
        <bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
          <dc:Bounds x="403" y="125" width="65" height="27" />
        </bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>

      <!-- Approve Loan Shape -->
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Shape_Task_ApproveLoan" bpmnElement="Task_ApproveLoan">
        <dc:Bounds x="530" y="70" width="100" height="80" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>

      <!-- Approved End Event Shape -->
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Shape_EndEvent_Approved" bpmnElement="EndEvent_Approved">
        <dc:Bounds x="690" y="92" width="36" height="36" />
        <bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
          <dc:Bounds x="672" y="135" width="75" height="14" />
        </bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>

      <!-- Send Rejection Shape -->
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Shape_Task_SendRejection" bpmnElement="Task_SendRejection">
        <dc:Bounds x="530" y="210" width="100" height="80" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>

      <!-- Rejected End Event Shape -->
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Shape_EndEvent_Rejected" bpmnElement="EndEvent_Rejected">
        <dc:Bounds x="690" y="232" width="36" height="36" />
        <bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
          <dc:Bounds x="674" y="275" width="71" height="14" />
        </bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>

      <!-- Edges / Sequence Flows -->
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Edge_Flow_To_CreditCheck" bpmnElement="Flow_To_CreditCheck">
        <di:waypoint x="196" y="180" />
        <di:waypoint x="250" y="180" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>

      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Edge_Flow_To_Gateway" bpmnElement="Flow_To_Gateway">
        <di:waypoint x="350" y="180" />
        <di:waypoint x="410" y="180" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>

      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Edge_Flow_Passed" bpmnElement="Flow_Passed">
        <di:waypoint x="435" y="155" />
        <di:waypoint x="435" y="110" />
        <di:waypoint x="530" y="110" />
        <bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
          <dc:Bounds x="444" y="130" width="18" height="14" />
        </bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>

      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Edge_Flow_Failed" bpmnElement="Flow_Failed">
        <di:waypoint x="435" y="205" />
        <di:waypoint x="435" y="250" />
        <di:waypoint x="530" y="250" />
        <bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
          <dc:Bounds x="444" y="223" width="15" height="14" />
        </bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>

      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Edge_Flow_To_ApprovedEnd" bpmnElement="Flow_To_ApprovedEnd">
        <di:waypoint x="630" y="110" />
        <di:waypoint x="690" y="110" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>

      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Edge_Flow_To_RejectedEnd" bpmnElement="Flow_To_RejectedEnd">
        <di:waypoint x="630" y="250" />
        <di:waypoint x="690" y="250" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
    </bpmndi:BPMNPlane>
  </bpmndi:BPMNDiagram>
</bpmn:definitions>

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"

                  xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI"
                  id="Definitions_Collaboration"
                  targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn">

  <!-- Collaboration Definition -->
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_1">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer" />
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Supplier" name="Supplier" processRef="Process_Supplier" />
    
    <!-- Message Flows -->
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PO" name="Purchase Order" sourceRef="Task_SendPO" targetRef="Task_ReceivePO" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Invoice" name="Invoice" sourceRef="Task_SendInvoice" targetRef="Task_ReceiveInvoice" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <!-- Customer Process -->
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Customer" name="Need Items">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendPO" name="Send Purchase Order">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveInvoice" name="Receive Invoice">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Customer" name="Order Completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C3</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Invoice" name="Invoice processing" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Invoice" name="Invoice received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Scan" name="Scan invoice">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Match" name="Match purchase order">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_To_Gateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Match" name="PO matched?" gatewayDirection="Diverging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_To_Gateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Match_Yes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Match_No</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <!-- Normal Approval Path -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Approve" name="Approve payment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Match_Yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Pay" name="Pay supplier">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Paid" name="Invoice paid">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <!-- Match Failure Path -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Query" name="Query supplier">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Match_No</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToEndQuery</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Disputed" name="Invoice rejected / disputed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToEndQuery</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

activate SMS

deactivate WebApp

activate WebApp

activate Auth

alt Code is Valid
    Auth -> Auth: Generate session token / JWT
    Auth --> WebApp: 200 OK (Auth Token & User Profile)
    WebApp --> User: Redirect to Dashboard / Logged In
else Code Invalid or Expired
    Auth --> WebApp: 401 Unauthorized (Invalid/Expired Code)
    deactivate Auth

    deactivate WebApp
